================================================================================
4. Absence checks -- the sentences that say the sources do NOT settle something
================================================================================

These are the report's own limits. A bare negative grep would prove only the pattern, so
each check pulls EVERY hit of a deliberately broad pattern out of the artifact, classifies
each hit, and prints the residual: hits no classification accounts for. Residual must be 0.
